column1: # PGSim's one-brake turns on the Ozone Geo 7 L: a second model's answer, for the flight model's turn
# Source: PGSim, this project's companion paraglider simulator (a single-page HTML flight simulator
#   built in the same project; engine build 1791983168-52fd), its own Geo 7 L OBJ, flown headless
#   in Node with its engine and EN 926-2 flight recorder unchanged
# Retrieved: 2026-11-24
# measure: computed, by PGSim; a model, not a flight: what a second, independently built model flies
# PGSim's defaults throughout (vortex lattice four panels a chord, brake cascade read from the
# OBJ's own brake lines, 0.08 m of free travel, 0.95 efficiency), at the all-up weight given; no
# weight shift, no speed bar, still air. From trim, the right brake from nothing at 1 s to the
# travel at 2 s, held. Each figure is the mean from 8 to 16 s; the turn's least and most in that
# window show how much it still swings.
# dynamics     rigid: one rigid body; two bodies: canopy and pilot joined by tension-only line
#              bundles, PGSim's default
# brake_droop  PGSim's brake droop: the braked strips roll outboard about their chords by this
#              many radians a unit of trailing-edge drop over chord, at most 8 degrees; 0 is a
#              rigid canopy. PGSim's default is 0.5
# turn_deg_s   the heading's rate, degrees a second
# bank_deg     the canopy's bank (roll), degrees
# sideslip_deg the canopy's sideslip, degrees (negative: the air from the left, outside a right turn)
# state        flying, or spiral where the sink passed 14 m/s within 17 s
# trim_speed_ms  PGSim's hands-up trim speed at this weight
